get.description:
The attempt with its time left; reading it after the time limit auto-submits it
with the answers saved so far (ST_11) and returns the result.

put.description:
Save answers as the user goes, so they count if the timer runs out.

After the time limit nothing more is saved: the attempt is auto-submitted with
what was saved before it and the result is returned.

post.description:
Submit the attempt and get the score straight away (UT_11).

Objective questions are scored deterministically, without the LLM. If questions
are unanswered the response names how many, e.g. "2 questions are unanswered"
(UT_12): under the ``warn`` rule submission waits for ``confirm: true`` (409 until
then); under ``block`` it is refused (422) until they are answered. Answers in the
request are saved either way. Once the time limit has passed the attempt is
auto-submitted regardless of the rule; only answered questions are scored and the
rest are marked unattempted (ST_11).

409.description: Unanswered questions under the "warn" rule: confirm to submit

get.description:

Pending or rejected Authorized Channels are visible only to the requester and to
admins; once approved they appear for everyone (ST_27).

post.description:
Create a channel; the creator becomes its owner and first member (UT_03).

Authorized Channels need ``channel:create_authorized`` (UT_04). One requested by an
authorized user waits for an admin's approval; one created by an admin is approved
at once, since the admin is the approver.

post.description: Approve a pending Authorized Channel; it becomes visible platform-wide (ST_27).

Join a channel found through search; membership takes effect at once (IT_03).

Only channels the caller can see are joinable, so a pending Authorized Channel
answers 404 to everyone but its requester and admins.

Leave a channel; it drops out of My Channels and its content closes (IT_04).

The creator cannot leave, since that would leave the channel without an owner.

get.description:
Search and filter materials (IT_07). Subject and topic together return only
materials matching both.

Without ``channel_id`` the search covers general materials and those in the
caller's channels; with it, that channel only, for its members. An empty result
carries ``empty_state`` for the UI.

post.description:
Upload a tagged study material (UT_07).

Subject, topic, semester and material type are all required; a blank one is refused
with its own message, e.g. ``Subject is required`` (UT_08). Files are checked for a
supported type and the size limit before anything is saved. A ``link`` material
carries a URL instead of a file. With ``channel_id`` the material is channel-scoped
and only that channel's members can see it.

get.description: One material with all its tags and file details.
The file as a download, under its original name (IT_08).
The file for viewing in the browser (IT_08): PDFs, images and text only.

Browse or search one bank (IT_09). The keyword matches question text, subject,
topic or explanation, ignoring case; the other filters narrow the results.

schema.title: Response Search Questions Api V1 Questions Get

post.description:
Add a question with its subject, topic, difficulty and type tags (UT_09).

Submission is refused with "Please select the correct answer" when no correct
answer is given (UT_10). With ``channel_id`` it goes to that channel's bank, which
needs channel membership; without it, to the general bank.

get.description: One question with its average rating and the caller's own rating.

put.description: Save the caller's 1-5 star rating (IT_09); rating again replaces it.

post.description:
Report a question (for example "Incorrect answer") to moderation (IT_09).

The report is logged as open in the moderation queue, scoped to the question's
channel so channel moderators see it. Reporting the same question again while the
first report is open returns that report instead of filing a duplicate.

Start the quiz; the timer starts now and ``remaining_seconds`` counts it down.

If the caller already has a running attempt at this quiz it is resumed (200) with
its answers and remaining time, so reloading the page does not restart the clock.
Non-members cannot attempt a channel quiz (403).

200.description: Resumed the caller's attempt that is still running

get.description: Return process health without exposing environment or database details.
